ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of the circle $O$, and point C is a point on circle $O$, $\angle ABC=70^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle BAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since AB is the diameter of circle O, and point C is a point on circle O,\\
it follows that $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle ABC=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAC=180^\circ-\left(\angle ACB+\angle ABC\right)=180^\circ-90^\circ-70^\circ=\boxed{20^\circ}$.
